description:
## Goal

Import the useful authoring, example, property, fuzz, system, load, live, and benchmark checks from the four source packages into the consolidated Jido project.

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`

## Global non-goals

- Do not change `lib/**`.
- Do not change `../refs/**`.
- Do not import historical benchmark result trees.
- Do not put provider or external service checks in the required offline gate.

## Definition of done

- Every reviewed asset has an exact source commit and disposition.
- All focused offline suites pass.
- Required CI runs every offline suite, Covenant, and Reach.
- Live and service suites are explicit and documented.

comments.text: Completed the full quality backpressure plan on local main at 71a1580e4e03f39d6c77c490a86ce54898859cf0. All 28 child tasks are closed. The repository now has versioned source dispositions; objective suite, threshold, waiver, and stability contracts; public module ownership; functional plus load/benchmark component proof; executable JSON/DSL authoring and example catalogs; bounded property/fuzz/system/load/peer/benchmark suites; common benchmark catalog and result schema; package/component/suite coverage; named offline CI jobs; and an enforced quality report. Final commands passed: mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test.ci, mix quality.coverage, mix quality.report, mix covenant.check, mix reach.check --arch --smells, mix test.bench, and mix quality. Final counts: unit/Covenant 3,337 passed and 468 excluded; authoring 74; examples 260; property 55; fuzz 13; system 5; load 3; peer 7; benchmark 30; Covenant 323/323. Coverage is 93.1726% package-wide, all 40 components pass at least 80%, and all ten suite contributions are recorded. The quality report passes with zero findings and zero waivers on a clean worktree. Live provider and external service success remain explicit opt-in checks; no unapproved key or unavailable service host was used. Reach reports 276 existing advisory smells, while architecture remains passing. No lib or refs file changed. Work is local and was not pushed.

title: Import consolidated quality backpressure
